How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIBF Chief Technology Officer Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 21-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIBF to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIBF Chief Technology Officer position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Chief Technology Officer post at IIBF is 21 September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Chief Technology Officer role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree in Engineering or MCA or an equivalent qualification from a recognized university to be eligible for this position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Chief Technology Officer recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 62 years as of 01 September 2026. There is no minimum age specified in the provided details.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the IIBF Chief Technology Officer post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Chief Technology Officer position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Chief Technology Officer role will receive an attractive annual salary package of Rs. 60,00,000 (60 Lakhs Per Annum).

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Chief Technology Officer post?
faq.answer: There is only one vacancy available for the post of Chief Technology Officer in the Indian Institute of Banking and Finance.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Chief Technology Officer position will primarily involve a Personal Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q8. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for a Contractual job position. The selected candidate will be appointed on a contract basis for the role of Chief Technology Officer.

faq.question: Q9. Which city and state is this job located in?
faq.answer: The job is located in Mumbai, Maharashtra, with a pincode of 400070. This is the operational base for the Chief Technology Officer role.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification PDF and the online application link in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
